title: 8-Day Western Turkey Tour: Aegean Highlights
metaTitle: Western Turkey Tour | Aegean Coast in 8 Days
metaDescription: Explore western Turkey from Istanbul to Pamukkale, Ephesus, Didyma and Pergamon on an 8-day route through the country's remarkable Aegean region.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
Turkey Tours & Packages 2026–2027 | Private & Small Group
summary:
The 8-Day Tour in Turkey takes a deeper look at Istanbul and the ancient civilizations of western Turkey, with more archaeological depth than a typical highlights itinerary. After exploring Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine heritage, continue to Ephesus and the ancient Ionian cities of Priene, Miletus and Didyma, followed by Pergamon, Pamukkale’s white travertine terraces and the ruins of Hierapolis.
The itinerary operates year-round, with travel dates and arrangements that can be adapted when needed. Your journey includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers and the scheduled sightseeing shown in the program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Izmir & Ephesus Tour
itinerary.text:
At 04:00, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your morning flight to Izmir at 07:00.
Upon arrival at 08:10, meet your guide and continue to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman ancient cities in the world. Explore its marble streets, the magnificent Library of Celsus, and the impressive Great Theatre. The tour also includes visits to the sacred House of the Virgin Mary and the remains of the Temple of Artemis. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale Day Trip
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” one of Turkey’s most remarkable natural wonders. Continue to the ancient city of Hierapolis and enjoy free time to swim at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Priene, Miletus & Didyma Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Priene, once one of the most important ancient Ionian cities. Continue to Miletus to explore its impressive theatre and Byzantine fortress. The tour concludes at Didyma, home to the magnificent Temple of Apollo, the largest Ionic temple of the ancient world, and the famous fallen head of Medusa. After the tour, transfer back to your hotel. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pergamon Tour & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:00, depart for Pergamon, one of the ancient world’s most important cultural centers. Explore the Acropolis, including the ancient Library, hillside Theatre, Altar of Zeus, and Temple of Athena. After the tour, transfer to Izmir Airport for your flight to Istanbul at 19:00. Upon arrival at 20:00, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Half Day Morning Bosphorus Cruise
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia on one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, return to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8 Day Western Turkey Tour?
faqs.a: The 8 Day Western Turkey Tour covers Istanbul, Pergamon, Pamukkale, Ephesus, and Didyma. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, visit the impressive Acropolis of Pergamon, discover Pamukkale's famous white travertine terraces, walk through the ancient city of Ephesus, and see the remarkable Temple of Apollo in Didyma. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8 Day Western Turkey Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,595 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this 8-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights help reduce travel time between destinations and allow you to spend more time exploring Western Turkey's rich historical and cultural attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 7 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the itinerary are included.

faqs.q: Does the 8 Day Western Turkey Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural background, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent choice for first-time visitors interested in Turkey's ancient history and archaeological heritage. It combines some of the country's most important classical sites with the cultural treasures of Istanbul, creating a well-rounded travel experience.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Ephesus, Pergamon, Pamukkale, and Didyma involve moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Pergamon, Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Didyma?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis of Pergamon, the Library of Celsus and Great Theatre in Ephesus, Pamukkale's stunning travertine terraces and Hierapolis ruins, and the impressive Temple of Apollo in Didyma, one of the most important oracle centers of the ancient world.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8 Day Western Turkey Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 8 Day Western Turkey Tour available all year and can it be customized
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional archaeological sites, or modify the itinerary to suit your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
